question: Which MUTCD table gives a fixed replacement interval, in years, for every type of traffic sign?
model_answer: Direct Answer: No such table exists in the evidence provided. None of the MUTCD tables in the evidence prescribes a fixed replacement interval in years for every type of traffic sign. The tables presented instead cover recommended letter/numeral sizes, warning sign spacing, sign dimensions, and FHWA target compliance dates — none of which set sign replacement schedules. The premise of the question appears to be based on a table that does not appear in the MUTCD evidence, so the question cannot be answered as posed. Support (informational): - Table 1B-1 lists "Target Compliance Dates Established by the FHWA" for specific provisions (e.g., Weight Limit Signs by January 18, 2029; maintaining minimum retroreflectivity of pavement markings by September 6, 2026). These are one-time compliance deadlines for adopting provisions, not recurring replacement intervals for signs. Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Table 2D-2 gives recommended minimum letter and numeral sizes for conventional road guide signs according to speed — not replacement intervals. - [Image 2] Figure 6B-1 illustrates the component parts of a temporary traffic control zone — unrelated to sign replacement schedules. - [Image 3] Table 6B-1 gives recommended advance warning sign minimum spacing distances by road type — not replacement intervals. - [Image 4] Table 1B-1 shows FHWA target compliance dates for specific MUTCD provisions, which are fixed calendar deadlines, not per-sign-type replacement intervals in years. - [Image 5] Page 26 is a table of contents page for Part 8 (grade crossings) and contains no replacement-interval table. - [Image 6] Page 104 shows Table 2A-5, Minimum Maintained Retroreflectivity Levels, which sets performance thresholds for sheeting, not replacement intervals in years. - [Image 7] Page 173 shows Figure 2B-28, Traffic Signal Signs and Plaques, which depicts sign designs only. - [Image 8] Page 23 is a table of contents page for Part 6 chapters and contains no replacement-interval table.
